messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency > 2.0s for streaming.generate in prod (us-west-2). rate: 15m sustained, anomaly score 8.2. auto-ticket #INC-4879 created.

oncall-alex: Saw the alert, I'm on it. p95 jumped from ~120ms -> 620ms, p99 ~2.1s. Streaming stalls reported by a few customers.

sre-maya: I'm pulling metrics now. Grafana: streaming.generate p95/p99 for us-west-2: 620ms / 2.1s. Cache hit rate for prefix cache dropped from 83% -> 4% in the last 30m.

eng-runtime-jun: Any recent deploys? I see a config change yesterday: prefix-key-rotation enabled for kvshard-3 at 02:14 UTC. Could be related.

oncall-alex: @jun yeah that matches timeline. Also saw a config push that set prefix_invalidation_ttl=0 for faster rotation (intent was immediate invalidation).

product-ops: Customer impact: support queue has 8 incidents referencing stalled streaming and partial responses. No outage, but SLOs breached for multiple tenants.

support-lina: Confirmed — three customers on Dedicated reported increased tail latency, one had retries triggered in their client. Sending list to AE.

eng-runtime-jun: Reproducing locally: when rotation invalidates a hot prefix, KV lookups fall back to disk/paging, and our streaming handler stalls waiting for page fetch. Low hit rate -> increased disk IOPS -> bigger tail.

sre-maya: Metrics snippet: 
```
metric: streaming.generate.latency.p99 = 2.12s
metric: cache.prefix.hit_rate (us-west-2) = 0.041
metric: kv.page_faults/sec = 420
```

oncall-alex: Immediate mitigation options? Can we rollback prefix rotation or re-enable TTL grace window to allow warmup?

eng-runtime-jun: Fastest is to revert the TTL=0 change to TTL=3600 (1h) so keys remain cached during rotation. Alternative: throttle new rotations and trigger cache pre-warm job.

sre-maya: I can patch the config in prod in ~5m. Plan: 1) set prefix_invalidation_ttl=3600 2) pause rotation job for kvshard-3 3) monitor p95/p99 and hit_rate.

oncall-alex: Go for it. Notify if we need rollback of the rotation code.

eng-runtime-jun: Command I'll run (prod control plane):
```
redwoodctl config set --env=prod --component=kv --kvshard=kvshard-3 prefix_invalidation_ttl=3600
redwoodctl job pause --job=prefix-rotation --shard=kvshard-3
```

eng-runtime-jun: Patching now.

incident-bot: ACTION: config change applied by eng-runtime-jun at 1758456183.

sre-maya: Watching metrics. p95 down from 620ms -> 210ms within ~3m. p99 trending down to 780ms. cache.hit_rate climbing to 45% and climbing.

product-ops: Nice, customer impact decreasing. Update on AEs: notifying top 3 affected customers about mitigation and ETA for full resolution.

support-lina: Customers acknowledged, one asked for postmortem.

oncall-alex: Next steps: 1) keep prefix_invalidation_ttl=3600 for 24h, 2) run background pre-warm for expired prefixes, 3) add a guard in rotation job that requires hit_rate>50% before mass invalidation, 4) postmortem owner?

eng-runtime-jun: I'll take the postmortem and the fix for rotation safeguards. Will open issue with checklist and tests.

sre-maya: Oncall notes: Incident severity: Sev2 (SLO breach, partial customer impact). Root cause preliminary: aggressive prefix rotation + invalidation TTL=0 caused massive cache miss storm -> paging and streaming stalls.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: Sev2 -> mitigation applied, monitoring.

noncall-alex: Handing off to day SRE for follow-up: @sre-maya you're primary for the next 8h, please continue watch and update channel if regressions.

sre-maya: Ack. I'll keep an eye and post updates every 30m until stable.

eng-runtime-jun: Follow-up tasks I'll create: (a) add canary during rotation to evaluate cache hit impact, (b) implement grace TTL setting in rotation controller, (c) pre-warm worker. ETA for code changes: 3 days for controller, 5 days for pre-warm pipeline.

product-ops: Please include expected customer-facing notes for the postmortem. We need to summarize timeline and compensating controls.

support-lina: Adding support log refs: INC-4879, tickets #CUST-1122,#CUST-1127,#CUST-1130.

sre-maya: 30m update: p95=180ms, p99=520ms, hit_rate=67%, kv.page_faults/sec down to 80. No new customer reports in last 20m.

oncall-alex: Great work. Will close thread to archive once postmortem link is posted. :thumbsup:

eng-runtime-jun: Postmortem issue opened: RDW-INF-1024. I'll ping when draft is ready.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: metrics stable, watch mode enabled. Resolution summary: reverted aggressive invalidation TTL, paused rotation, pre-warm plan and controller safeguards in progress.

sre-maya: Closing notes: if we see another spike, escalate to infra on-call and consider temporary rate-limit on streaming.generate for affected tenants.

support-lina: Closing customer tickets where possible.

oncall-alex: Thanks team. Handed off to @sre-maya for follow-up.

sre-maya: End of thread update at 1758456600: incident moved to postmortem stage.
